CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION proof_indexer.reject_work_transition_archive_mutation_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Immutable transition evidence'; END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION proof_indexer.work_transition_metadata_v1(p jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT (p-ARRAY['openingSufficientState','closingSufficientState','closingTokenState','closingIdState','closingGenericTokenState','closingWorkProjection']::text[])
  ||CASE WHEN (p->'closingSufficientState') ? 'tokenStateCommitment'
  THEN jsonb_build_object('closingSufficientState',jsonb_build_object('tokenStateCommitment',p->'closingSufficientState'->'tokenStateCommitment')) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
$function$

relations.name: work_batch_transition_supersessions_v1
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX work_batch_transition_supersessions_v1_network_block_height_key ON proof_indexer.work_batch_transition_supersessions_v1 USING btree (network, block_height)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX work_batch_transition_supersessions_v1_pkey ON proof_indexer.work_batch_transition_supersessions_v1 USING btree (network, block_hash)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_work_batch_supersession_v1 BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON proof_indexer.work_batch_transition_supersessions_v1 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION proof_indexer.reject_work_transition_archive_mutation_v1()
constraints: CHECK (((((old_main ->> 'network'::text) = network) AND (((old_main ->> 'block_height'::text))::integer = block_height) AND ((old_main ->> 'block_hash'::text) = block_hash)) IS TRUE))

CHECK (((((new_metadata - 'event_set_sha256'::text) = (old_main - ARRAY['payload'::text, 'created_at'::text, 'event_set_sha256'::text])) AND ((new_metadata ->> 'event_set_sha256'::text) = ((replacement_fields -> 'eventSetCommitment'::text) ->> 'sha256'::text)) AND ((new_metadata ->> 'event_set_sha256'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) IS TRUE))

CHECK ((((jsonb_typeof(replacement_fields) = 'object'::text) AND (replacement_fields ?& ARRAY['workBatchV1'::text, 'transitionChainCommitment'::text, 'replayRecords'::text, 'replayDescriptorCommitment'::text, 'traces'::text, 'eventSetCommitment'::text]) AND ((replacement_fields - ARRAY['workBatchV1'::text, 'transitionChainCommitment'::text, 'replayRecords'::text, 'replayDescriptorCommitment'::text, 'traces'::text, 'eventSetCommitment'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((replacement_fields -> 'replayRecords'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length((replacement_fields -> 'replayRecords'::text)) <= 2048) AND (jsonb_typeof((replacement_fields -> 'traces'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length((replacement_fields -> 'traces'::text)) <= 2048) AND (jsonb_typeof((replacement_fields -> 'replayDescriptorCommitment'::text)) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((replacement_fields -> 'eventSetCommitment'::text)) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((replacement_fields -> 'transitionChainCommitment'::text)) = 'object'::text)) IS TRUE))

CHECK ((((jsonb_typeof(relational_bindings) = 'object'::text) AND (relational_bindings ?& ARRAY['eventCount'::text, 'eventRowsSha256'::text, 'recordCount'::text, 'recordRowsSha256'::text]) AND ((relational_bindings - ARRAY['eventCount'::text, 'eventRowsSha256'::text, 'recordCount'::text, 'recordRowsSha256'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND ((((relational_bindings ->> 'recordCount'::text))::integer >= 0) AND (((relational_bindings ->> 'recordCount'::text))::integer <= 1024)) AND ((((relational_bindings ->> 'eventCount'::text))::integer >= ((relational_bindings ->> 'recordCount'::text))::integer) AND (((relational_bindings ->> 'eventCount'::text))::integer <= (2 * ((relational_bindings ->> 'recordCount'::text))::integer))) AND ((relational_bindings ->> 'eventRowsSha256'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND ((relational_bindings ->> 'recordRowsSha256'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) IS TRUE))

SELECT network,
    block_height,
    block_hash,
    previous_block_hash,
    model,
    state_commitment_model,
    opening_network_value_q8,
    closing_network_value_q8,
    opening_state_sha256,
    closing_state_sha256,
    opening_state_payload_bytes,
    closing_state_payload_bytes,
    protocol_record_count,
    raw_protocol_candidate_count,
    transaction_count,
    event_count,
    event_set_model,
    event_set_sha256,
    event_set_payload_bytes,
    block_atomic,
    fee_once,
    invalid_zero,
    complete,
    proof_indexer.reconstruct_work_transition_payload_v1(payload) AS payload,
    created_at,
    work_token_state_model
   FROM proof_indexer.work_transition_archive_v1;

relations.name: work_transition_archive_v1
indexes: CREATE INDEX work_transition_archive_height_v1 ON proof_indexer.work_transition_archive_v1 USING btree (network, block_height)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX work_transition_archive_v1_pkey ON proof_indexer.work_transition_archive_v1 USING btree (network, block_hash)
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER immutable_frames BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON proof_indexer.work_transition_archive_v1 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION proof_indexer.reject_work_transition_archive_mutation_v1()
constraints: CHECK (((block_atomic = true) AND (fee_once = true) AND (invalid_zero = true) AND (complete = true)))

CHECK (((opening_state_payload_bytes > 0) AND (closing_state_payload_bytes > 0) AND (protocol_record_count >= 0) AND (raw_protocol_candidate_count >= 0) AND (transaction_count >= 0) AND (event_count >= 0) AND (event_set_payload_bytes > 0)))

CHECK (((model = ANY (ARRAY['canonical-work-amo-full-position-block-sequencer-v1'::text, 'canonical-work-amo-full-position-block-sequencer-v2'::text, 'canonical-work-amo-full-position-block-sequencer-v3'::text, 'canonical-work-amo-full-position-block-sequencer-v4'::text])) AND (state_commitment_model = 'canonical-work-amo-sufficient-state-sha256-v1'::text) AND (((model = ANY (ARRAY['canonical-work-amo-full-position-block-sequencer-v1'::text, 'canonical-work-amo-full-position-block-sequencer-v2'::text])) AND (work_token_state_model IS NULL)) OR ((model = 'canonical-work-amo-full-position-block-sequencer-v3'::text) AND (work_token_state_model = 'canonical-work-token-state-subatoms-v2'::text)) OR ((model = 'canonical-work-amo-full-position-block-sequencer-v4'::text) AND (work_token_state_model = 'canonical-work-token-state-subatoms-v3'::text))) AND (event_set_model = 'canonical-work-amo-event-set-sha256-v1'::text)))
